purpose: Five hostile enemy idle sprites for levels 1–10 in the browser MMORPG
referencesUsage: Existing NPC art was inspected visually and translated into text-only style guidance; each enemy was generated independently in one built-in call.

format.poses: one full-body idle pose per image
format.orientation: slight elevated three-quarter front view facing down-right

frameConvention.coordinates: top-left x/y; width/height; source image pixels
frameConvention.note: Original files are unedited copies. Built-in output contains a few invisible alpha 1–7 pixels beyond the visible silhouette. frame uses alpha >= 8 for practical rendering, while alphaBBox records every alpha > 0 pixel.

assets.name: Zdziczały szczur
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original enemy sprite for a browser medieval fantasy MMORPG, readable when displayed at 56–70 pixels. Scene/backdrop: fully transparent alpha everywhere outside the subject. Style/medium: compact chibi RPG sprite with sharp dark outlines, chunky clustered pixel-art inspired painted shading, subtle textured highlights, subdued warm medieval fantasy palette. Match a game whose human NPCs have large heads, short sturdy bodies, broad readable boots, deep brown outlines, muted olive and leather colors. Composition: ONE complete full-body subject, slight elevated three-quarter front view, facing down-right (south-east), neutral alert idle stance, centered within generous transparent margins. Complete silhouette including every foot, tail and any weapon entirely inside the canvas. No ground, cast shadow, aura, backdrop, vignette, text, labels, checkerboard, border, extra poses, extra characters, sprite sheet, gore, photorealism, blur or modern objects. Genuine transparent PNG, square canvas. Subject: ONE hostile feral rat. Ragged earthy brown fur, squat low quadruped body, hunched shoulders, pointed muzzle, rounded torn-looking ears, dark bead eyes, four little pink-brown clawed feet and one long curling bare tail clearly visible. Tiny bared incisors and wary posture communicate hostility without gore. Small ordinary forest rat proportions, natural animal anatomy. Fur rendered as readable large dark brown clusters with tan highlights.

review.visual: Reviewed full-body silhouette, orientation, distinct subject, complete feet/tail/weapons, absence of backdrop and text.
review.alpha: Verified RGBA alpha extrema 0–255 and fully transparent pixels using read-only Pillow inspection.
review.processing: Copied original PNG byte-for-byte; no cropping, resizing or image editing.
